To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) LexRank can be used to improve passage retrieval performance in a variety of settings, including question answering, topic-focused summarization and text clustering; and 2) Biased LexRank can be applied to question answering to improve retrieval performance.

(1) Biased LexRank is a method for semi supervised passage retrieval in the question answering context, (2) Biased LexRanks uses traditional passage retrieval techniques and a random walk on a lexical similarity graph to identify relevant passages and (3) the results on several benchmarks demonstrate the applicability of Biased LexRank to question answering and text summarization.

1) Biased LexRank outperforms the state of the art on two question answering tasks, 2) Biased Lexrank is robust to the choice of lexical similarity measure, and 3) Biased LexRanks is robust to the number of initial relevant passages.
